name: tr-address-country
title: Countries with Turkish names
description: The 250 countries and territories with an ISO 3166-1 code (plus Kosovo, XK), with Turkish and English names, international calling code, capital in Turkish and English with its coordinates, continent, currency and internet domain. Intended for country pick lists and address forms in Turkish-language applications.

licenses.name: Unicode-3.0
licenses.title: Unicode License v3 (country names from Unicode CLDR)

sources.title: GeoNames, countryInfo.txt: ISO codes, capital, calling code, continent, currency, top-level domain (CC BY 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-05
GeoNames, cities500.zip and IO.zip: capital records (PPLC and four listed exceptions) and their coordinates (CC BY 4.0), retrieved 2026-11-05
Unicode CLDR 49, cldr-localenames-full, territories in tr and en: country names (Unicode License v3)
Wikidata: Turkish names of capitals, from the Turkish Wikipedia article title or Turkish label of the item matched by GeoNames ID (P1566) or as the country's capital (P36) (CC0), retrieved 2026-11-05
ISO 4217 List One (see world-currencies): currency of Bulgaria (EUR)

fields.name: code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. XK (Kosovo) is a user-assigned code, not an official ISO 3166-1 code.

fields.name: alpha_3_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. XKX for Kosovo is user-assigned.

fields.name: numeric_code
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code, zero-padded (004, not 4). Empty for Kosovo, which has none.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Country name in Turkish, the default form in Unicode CLDR.

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Country name in English, the default form in Unicode CLDR.

fields.name: calling_code
fields.description: International calling code (ITU-T E.164 country code) without + or 00, from GeoNames. For territories sharing a code, the area code follows a hyphen (1-268, 44-1481). Several codes are separated by semicolons (1-809;1-829). Empty where GeoNames has none.

fields.name: capital
fields.description: Capital in Turkish, from Wikidata. Empty when there is no capital or no Turkish name was found.

fields.name: capital_en
fields.description: Capital in English as named by GeoNames. Empty for territories without a capital.

fields.name: capital_latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the capital in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from GeoNames.

fields.name: capital_longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the capital in decimal degrees (WGS 84), from GeoNames.

fields.name: capital_geonames_id
fields.description: GeoNames ID of the capital record the coordinates come from (https://www.geonames.org/<id>).

fields.name: continent_code
fields.description: Continent as coded by GeoNames: AF Africa, AN Antarctica, AS Asia, EU Europe, NA North America, OC Oceania, SA South America.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.description: Main currency, ISO 4217 alphabetic code. References code in world-currencies. Empty for Antarctica.

fields.name: tld
fields.description: Country-code top-level internet domain, with the leading dot. Empty for Kosovo.
